sources.title: Haidian site package
sources.usage: Machine-readable brief, scope, allowed design space, ranges, schemas, and source inventory.
sources.limitations: The provisional geometry in the package is not an official redline.

sources.title: Source usability registry
sources.usage: Separates formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
sources.limitations: A registry classification does not replace professional source verification.

sources.title: Agent-readable processed fact pack
sources.usage: Navigation layer for scope, tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing data; not a new authority source.
sources.limitations: Claims must return to the registered source materials.

sources.title: Provisional site boundary geometry
sources.usage: Input for the submitted provisional boundary and topology-safe design layers.
sources.limitations: Conceptual reference only; official_boundary=false and precision is provisional.

sources.title: Provisional key-area geometry
sources.usage: Input for the three required detailed-design key areas.
sources.limitations: The three polygons are provisional constraints, not cadastral or statutory boundaries.

sources.title: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
sources.publisher: 北京市规划和自然资源委员会海淀分局
sources.usage: Official scope, tasks, key areas, and competition deliverable context.
sources.limitations: The source package preserves a local reading copy; the live page is authoritative for later updates.

sources.title: AI urban design open-call taskbook
sources.usage: Agent-facing six tasks, scenario, naming, visual, operation, and human-review boundaries.
sources.limitations: It defines an open-call response contract and is not a statutory approval document.

sources.title: Agent open-call taskbook 0518
sources.usage: Human-readable task interpretation used to structure the proposal and evidence package.
sources.limitations: The JSON taskbook remains the machine-readable contract.

sources.title: Provisional boundary disclosure
sources.usage: Explicitly discloses the geometry precision, official-boundary status, and re-computation trigger.
sources.limitations: All spatial values derived from it are provisional.

sources.title: Beijing Haidian qualification pre-announcement
sources.publisher: Beijing Municipal Commission of Planning and Natural Resources, Haidian Branch
sources.usage: Scope and official brief context for the open call.
sources.limitations: No inferred geometry is promoted to an official control line.

sources.title: Three key areas and two-wing innovation structure
sources.usage: Design brief for the three key areas, two wings, and five coordinated functions.
sources.limitations: Names and spatial translations remain proposal-level interpretations.

sources.title: 城市设计管理办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.usage: Reference for urban-design coordination, public-space quality, and city-character governance.
sources.limitations: Applied here as a professional reference; local statutory controls still govern implementation.

sources.title: 城市、镇控制性详细规划编制审批办法
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国住房和城乡建设部
sources.usage: Reference for control-planning-level content, implementation conditions, and non-fabrication of controls.
sources.limitations: Specific local control values, legal status, and approval paths are not provided in the open-call package.

sources.title: Haidian 1+X+1 spatial coordination reference
sources.usage: Reference for one heritage spine, one innovation belt, and one public-life network as a design reading.
sources.limitations: The proposal translates the taskbook into a concept; it does not assert a new planning boundary.

sources.title: 国土空间调查、规划、用途管制用地用海分类指南
sources.publisher: 中华人民共和国自然资源部
sources.usage: Reference for land-use code interpretation in the conceptual land-use layer.
sources.limitations: Conceptual polygons do not determine statutory parcel or land-use approval.

sources.title: Amap POI and geocoding cross-check
sources.path: tool result: POI text search and geocoding
sources.usage: Cross-checks the public naming and transit context of AI Origin Community, Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park, Dazhongsi station, Wudaokou station, and Qinghe station.
sources.collection_method: Read-only Amap MCP text-search and geocoding calls; no map tiles, photos, or POI geometry were copied into the package.
sources.coverage: Current POI search responses around Haidian, Beijing; names and coordinates returned by the provider.
sources.limitations: Search is ambiguous for the name 众智园 and provider data may change. This record is QA/background only and cannot define official boundaries, land use, areas, or engineering controls.

sources.title: Amap walking connectivity cross-check
sources.path: tool result: walking route and distance calls
sources.usage: Tests the conceptual walking chain from AI Origin Community to Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park and onward to Dazhongsi station.
sources.collection_method: Read-only Amap MCP walking-route and distance calls using geocoded POI centers.
sources.coverage: AI Origin Community to Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park: 728 m walking route; heritage park to Dazhongsi station: 3,378 m walking route.
sources.limitations: Route distance is a current routing observation, not a measured design metric, official accessibility survey, or proposed road alignment.

sources.title: Helsinki AI Register
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for making public-sector AI use cases legible and reviewable.
sources.limitations: A governance mechanism reference, not evidence about Beijing or Haidian.

sources.title: Amsterdam algorithm register
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for publishing algorithm purpose, risk, and accountability information.
sources.limitations: A comparative governance mechanism reference only.

sources.title: Decidim participatory democracy platform
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for traceable proposals, public comments, and response loops.
sources.limitations: The proposal borrows the participation pattern, not the platform brand or deployment claim.

sources.title: Singapore Open Government Products
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for small, reusable, citizen-facing digital services with public value.
sources.limitations: A comparative product-delivery mechanism reference only.

sources.title: Seoul S-Map spatial digital twin
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for spatial simulation, evidence views, and scenario testing before physical change.
sources.limitations: A digital-twin mechanism reference; no local digital twin is claimed here.

sources.title: Virtual Singapore
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for a shared 3D city model and cross-agency scenario exploration.
sources.limitations: A comparative mechanism reference; not a claim of equivalent data availability.

sources.title: Barcelona superblock public-space transformation
sources.path: case-study: reversible street and public-space pilots
sources.usage: Mechanism reference for street reallocation, pilotable public space, and measurable mobility change.
sources.limitations: A comparative urban-design mechanism reference; local traffic and fire review remains mandatory.
